name: ai.slidingbox/hydrate-dehydrate
title: Slidingbox Hydrate/Dehydrate
description: Encrypted one-time secret handoff, x402 pre-flight, and web page change checks and watches.

environmentVariables.name: SLIDINGBOX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Evaluation key (sbk_<id>.<hmac>) covering a fixed number of free reads. Get one instantly with: curl -X POST https://slidingbox.ai/v1/key

environmentVariables.name: SLIDINGBOX_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Base wallet private key holding USDC. Reads cost $0.02 each, paid per call over x402. Use a wallet funded for this and nothing else.

environmentVariables.name: SLIDINGBOX_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: CAIP-2 chain for payment. Base mainnet by default.
